coverage.hsr: 31 historical releases, launch through 4.6. Official announcements are supplemented with a regional-normalized banner archive.
coverage.zzz: 20 historical releases, launch through 3.2. Official announcements are supplemented with community version history and reporting. The upcoming version number 3.3 is confirmed independently of the projected date.
coverage.endfield: Six historical releases, launch through Dreamscape of Wind and Snow. Official announcements are supplemented with the community version index. The upcoming title Sanctuary of Ink is confirmed; a numerical 1.6 label is not asserted as official.

caveats: This is a manually researched snapshot, not a live news feed. No future release after the latest anchor was verified for inclusion on October 4, 2026.

Official means backed by a publisher announcement or publisher-authored release material. Archive means reported by a secondary source, not independently verified here against the original maintenance notice.

A stored date is pinned exactly, including exceptional weekdays. Projected dates are calculations, never announcements. Historical records can still require correction; this is not an exhaustive official-source audit.

Artwork is linked to official public media. The optional asset downloader can copy it into this repository. Public availability is not a redistribution license; rights remain with the respective publishers.
